newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber mixed in noon trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber mixed in noon trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally mixed in sluggish trading at midday on Monday, traders said.

They said offer prices were unchanged at 49.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for May/June shipment but were down 0.25 cents fob Surabaya at 49.25. Bids were reported at 49.00 fob Palembang, down from last week's offer price of 49.25.
Levels were slightly higher fob Jambi at 49.00 against 48.75 last week but offer prices were unchanged at 48.75 fob Pontianak.
"Market sentiment is still weak as we don't see any factors which can boost it," said one trader.
Traders said prices could dip further because supplies were abundant, with some seeing prices falling to as low as 45.00 cents if the bearish trend continued.
